description: Helps you decide how big your market is, counted bottom up. You give how many companies could buy and your annual contract value in dollars, plus your ICP match rate and year 1 share if you have them. You get TAM, SAM and SOM with the arithmetic and assumptions shown and a summary for an investor deck. It is a calculator, not a data source: a rate you leave out is filled with a labelled example, and sector notes are added when your inputs name a supported sector. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of impact_anchor_market when you have a chosen market and need bottom-up market arithmetic.

average_contract_value.description: Your average ACV in dollars. Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

data_sources.description: Where you got your numbers (for documentation). Format is text. For example, "internal customer records reviewed in October 2026".

icp_percentage.description: Percentage of those companies that match your ICP, from 0 to 100. Left out, 30 is used and marked as an example. Format is a JSON number.

product_category.description: Optional: what you sell (for example "spend management software"), used for sector notes. The arithmetic does not use it. Format is text.

segment_name.description: Name of the market segment. Format is text. For example, "manufacturers with 200 to 500 employees".

total_potential_companies.description: Estimated total companies that could buy (from LinkedIn, industry reports). Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

year1_market_share_target.description: Assumed Year 1 share percentage, from 0 to 100. This is a planning assumption, not evidence of attainable share. Left out, 3 is used and marked as an example. Format is a JSON number.

name: tam_sam_som_calculator
title: TAM SAM SOM Calculator
